phaseAssignment: SHA256(stageId|seed) final hex nibble parity; even=namua, odd=mtaji
sourcePolicy: deterministic seeded random legal play from standard initial state
candidateRule: nonterminal roots at ply >= 16 in assigned phase; one root per source by minimum SHA256(stageId|seed|ply|rootRawSha256)
candidateOrder: Namua then Mtaji; within phase sourceSeed ascending, selectedPly ascending, rootRawSha256 lexicographic
identityFirewall: CRCLGR Stage 1 complete candidate identity exclusion
measuredPopulationRule: first 36 resource-eligible roots per phase in frozen canonical candidate order after all 96 preflight rows are complete
